title: Kapibara preflight input
description: Input accepted by kapibara_preflight and the core preflight function. Additional fields are allowed.

intent.description: The user's intent. Used for rule matching.

action.description: Concrete action verb, such as deploy, delete file, or send email.

target.description: Exact path, branch, environment, recipient, package, or resource.

context.description: Facts the engine cannot infer from the action and target.

metadata.description: Extra fields. command, content, branch, files, migration, environment, and recursive are used.

files.description: Explicit workspace-relative files to scan. Directories are never crawled.

scanTarget.description: Scan the single named target for outbound actions. The target must stay inside the workspace.
